meta.title: Meridian — Finance, health & habits on your terms
meta.description: Meridian is a local-first personal organiser for finance, health, tasks, and habits. Imports your bank statements, automates the repetitive parts, runs entirely on your machine.

hero.subhead: Import your bank statement, Meridian handles the rest — categories, budgets, goals, health, habits. Everything on your machine. No accounts, no cloud, no data handed to anyone.

story.label: Why Meridian exists
story.title: Started on a weekend. Still here.
story.p1: Too many spreadsheets. One for the budget, one for the debts, one for everything else. Every month: export the bank statement, paste the columns, hope nothing had broken. One weekend I wrote a script to do the import for me.
story.p2: Then I wanted to see the spending as a chart. Then auto-categories. Then net worth and projections. Then debt schedules, tasks, reminders. Then health metrics and habits — it was all there already, and it made sense to have the full picture in one place.
story.p3: I never planned to build an app. It grew on weekends, one version at a time. The data is still on my machine, the monthly import is still one click, and there are no spreadsheets left.
story.card1_body: Most finance apps read and process your data in the cloud. Meridian imports your bank files directly — nothing is transmitted, nothing is analysed remotely. Your data never leaves your machine.
story.card2_body: Spreadsheets work until they break silently. Meridian's rule-based auto-categorisation, debt payment detection, and recurring tasks run automatically on every import — no formula babysitting required.
story.card3_title: One app for the full picture
story.card3_body: Finance, health metrics, habits, and tasks live in the same local database. Goals link to your account balances. Health reminders fire alongside task due dates. Context stays connected instead of scattered across five apps.

import_sec.label: Import
import_sec.title: Works with your bank file
import_sec.sub: Drop in an export from your bank. Meridian reads the columns, maps them to the right fields, and remembers your format for next time — so future imports need one click.
import_sec.card1_body: Any spreadsheet export from any bank. A column mapper lets you assign date, description, amount, and balance fields from the detected header row. Multiple tabs supported — Meridian picks the right one automatically.
import_sec.card2_body: Handles multi-page, multi-column PDF bank extracts. After reading the PDF, it checks the running balance adds up across all pages — so you know immediately if a page was missed.
import_sec.card3_body: Fixed-width TXT files from online banking portals. The year is inferred automatically from your existing transaction history — no manual date adjustment needed.
import_sec.note: Duplicate detection runs on every import — re-uploading the same file is always safe. Imported count and skipped duplicates are shown after each run.

privacy_sec.label: Privacy
privacy_sec.title: Built private from the ground up
privacy_sec.sub: Most apps monetise your behaviour. Meridian earns nothing from your data — because it never sees it.
privacy_sec.tagline: Optional anonymous install ping — no personal data, opt-in only.
privacy_sec.card1_body: Everything lives in a SQLite file on your own machine. Transactions, health metrics, habits, tasks — none of it touches an external server.
card1_items: AES-GCM encrypted backup — client-side, your password only
privacy_sec.card2_body: There is no Meridian account. No email sign-up, no session on our servers. You log in with WebAuthn passkeys on your own device — credentials stay on-device.
card2_items: No email required to use the app
privacy_sec.card3_body: Export your entire dataset as JSON any time. Move to a new machine, audit it, back it up — Meridian never holds your data hostage.

finance.label: Finance
finance.title: More than a budget tracker
finance.sub: Six views from a single import: monthly breakdown, year-over-year comparison, budget tracking, goal progress, debt schedules, and a forward-looking plan.
finance.card1_body: Set per-category targets. Every import updates the progress bars — over-budget categories surface immediately, with one click to drill down to the individual transactions responsible.
finance.card2_body: Every month view shows the same period last year alongside, with the percentage change. Spending drift is visible at a glance — no pivot tables, no manual calculations.
finance.card3_body: Expenses appearing in 3 or more of the last 6 months with consistent amounts are flagged automatically — subscriptions, utilities, standing orders — without any manual tagging.
finance.card4_body: Import from any number of accounts. Overview and planning views filter per-account or show everything combined. Net worth includes all account balances automatically.
finance.card5_body: Assets versus debts over time, plotted as an area chart. Built from your import history — updated automatically each time new transactions come in, with no manual input.
finance.card6_body: Six-month rolling average, calculated automatically from your income and expense history. No formula to maintain — it updates on every import and shows you the trend over time.
finance.card7_body: Set percentage thresholds on any goal or debt. Meridian fires a push notification the moment you cross 50% or hit 100% — triggered automatically as new transactions are imported.
finance.card8_body: Standard amortisation for mortgages and loans: full payment schedule with principal/interest split, extra payment logging, and a keyword that auto-detects payments on import and keeps the balance current.

health.label: Health & habits
health.title: Your daily picture, in one place
health.sub: Health metrics, habits, and tasks live in the same app as your finances. No context switching — your home screen shows everything at once.
health.card1_body: Your daily view: habits to check off, tasks due today, budget status, and today's health log — all in one screen. Overdue items stay highlighted until resolved.
health.card2_body: Log weight, sleep, mood, water — or define your own metrics with custom names, units, and colours. Set a goal per metric and see your daily gap at a glance. Trend charts over 30 or 90 days.
health.card3_body: Daily habit tracking alongside your health log. Each habit shows a current streak, a 7-day week grid, and a 30-day completion rate. Check off from the home screen or the Health tab.
health.card4_body: Install as a PWA on your phone and reach Meridian from any device on your local network — or over Tailscale from anywhere. No port forwarding, no cloud relay, no exposure.

automations.label: Automations
automations.title: The repetitive parts, handled
automations.sub: Every automation runs locally, on your machine, with no external API calls.
automations.card1_body: Define keyword rules once. Every import is classified automatically — groceries, utilities, subscriptions — without touching a single transaction by hand. Rules can be applied back through your existing history.
automations.card2_body: Assign a keyword to each debt. When a matching transaction is imported, Meridian logs the payment and reduces the outstanding balance — no manual update needed.
automations.card3_body: Get notified when a budget is exceeded after an import, when it's time to log your health metrics, or when a task is due — delivered via your device's notification system, no third-party service involved.
automations.card4_body: Set up to two percentage thresholds per goal or debt — say 50% and 100%. Meridian fires a notification the moment a threshold is crossed, triggered automatically as transactions arrive.

full_tier.label: Full tier
full_tier.title: Stay current, without the effort
full_tier.sub: Full adds the features that do the analysis for you — and keeps the app updated as Meridian grows.
full_tier.item1_body: Your assets, debts, and 6-month rolling savings rate — calculated automatically from import history. See where you are and where you're headed without lifting a finger.
full_tier.item2_body: Set percentage thresholds once. Meridian notifies you automatically when you cross them — as soon as a new import hits, not days later when you remember to check.
full_tier.item3_body: Query your financial and health data from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant. Read-only, password-protected, entirely local — your data is the context, nothing is sent to a third party.
full_tier.item4_body: Every new Meridian release is delivered automatically while your subscription is active. The app gets better without you doing anything.
full_tier.coming1_body: EnableBanking (PSD2) integration for supported EU banks — transactions arrive automatically instead of a monthly manual export. XLS upload stays as fallback.
full_tier.coming2_body: Ask plain-English questions answered by your own data via Ollama — "what did I spend on food last quarter?" — entirely offline, using the MCP tools already in Full.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Two paths. Both private.
pricing.sub: Base has everything you need, once, forever. Full adds deeper analysis and continuous updates — for when you don't want to think about it.
pricing.footnote:
Trial and Base are version-locked — the license you buy stays valid for the version installed; no future updates are delivered.
Full subscribers receive all software updates while their annual subscription is active.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download and be running in minutes
download.sub: Install the Electron app on Windows. Your 31-day trial starts on first launch — no credit card, no account.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy — Meridian
privacy_page.s1_body: Meridian is a local-only personal organiser for finance, health, tasks, and habits. All data you enter is stored exclusively on your own device. Meridian does not operate servers that receive, store, or process your personal information.
s2_items: No account registration — there is no Meridian cloud account.
No usage analytics or behavioural telemetry.
No advertising identifiers or third-party tracking.
No crash reports sent to Meridian servers.
privacy_page.s2b_body: During installation you may opt in to a single anonymous install ping. If you opt in, the app sends one request containing only the app version and operating system — no personal data, no identifiers, and no usage information. This helps us count installs. It is off by default, and declining it has no effect on the app.
privacy_page.s3_title: Data stored locally on your device
privacy_page.s3_body: Everything you enter into Meridian — transactions, budgets, health metrics, tasks, habits, and any imported bank statements — is stored in a SQLite database on your own machine (%APPDATA%\Meridian\ on Windows, or a Docker volume you control). This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly export a backup file.
privacy_page.s4_body: Meridian sets a single session cookie to keep you logged in. This cookie is stored only in your local browser and is never transmitted to any Meridian server.
privacy_page.s5_body: If you connect Google Fit, Meridian uses Google's OAuth 2.0 flow to request read-only access to your fitness data. The OAuth token is stored locally on your device. Health data fetched from Google Fit is written to your local database and is not transmitted anywhere else. You can disconnect Google Fit at any time from Settings → Health.
privacy_page.s6_body: If you enable push notifications, your browser generates a push subscription endpoint (provided by your browser vendor's push service — e.g. Google FCM for Chrome). This endpoint is stored locally and used only to deliver notifications from your own Meridian instance to your own device. Meridian does not use it for any other purpose.
privacy_page.s7_body: The Electron desktop app checks for updates via GitHub Releases (github.com/LfmaSL/Meridian/releases). This check sends a standard HTTPS request to GitHub's servers (subject to GitHub's Privacy Statement). No personal data from inside the app is included in this request.
privacy_page.s8_body: License purchases are processed by Paddle.com Market Limited, acting as Merchant of Record. When you purchase a license, you interact directly with Paddle's checkout — Meridian does not receive or store your payment details. Paddle's handling of your payment data is governed by Paddle's Privacy Policy.
privacy_page.s9_body: Because Meridian stores data only on your device, you have full control at all times. You can export, delete, or reset all data from Settings → Data. There is no cloud account to close.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: These terms govern your purchase and use of Meridian, a desktop application for personal finance, health, task, and habit tracking. By installing the app or purchasing a license you agree to these terms.

sections.title: Licenses and tiers
sections.body: Meridian offers a free 31-day trial, a Base license, and a Full subscription. The trial and Base licenses are version-locked: they remain valid indefinitely for the version installed at the time of purchase, and no future updates are included. The Full subscription is billed annually and includes all software updates while it is active. Licenses are for personal use on devices you own or control, and may not be resold or redistributed.

sections.title: Payments
sections.body: Purchases are processed by Paddle.com Market Limited, acting as Merchant of Record. Paddle handles checkout, invoicing, applicable taxes, and payment data, governed by Paddle's own terms and privacy policy. Meridian never receives your payment details.

sections.title: Subscriptions and cancellation
sections.body: Full subscriptions renew annually until cancelled. You can cancel at any time via the link in your Paddle receipt or by contacting support. Cancellation stops future renewals; the app continues to work at the last version delivered to you.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Refunds are handled according to our Refund Policy, available on this site.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not share, resell, or redistribute license keys, or attempt to circumvent license validation. Reverse engineering is not permitted except to the extent allowed by applicable law.

sections.title: No financial advice
sections.body: Meridian is a record-keeping and visualisation tool. Nothing in the app constitutes financial, investment, tax, or health advice.

sections.title: Warranty and liability
sections.body: The app is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind to the maximum extent permitted by law. Our total liability arising from or related to the app is limited to the amount you paid for it in the twelve months preceding the claim. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law, or affects your statutory rights as a consumer.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of the app after a change constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal. If you are a consumer, you also benefit from any mandatory protections of the law of your country of residence.

sections.title: Try before you buy
sections.body: Meridian offers a full 31-day free trial with no credit card required. We encourage you to use the trial to make sure the app fits your needs before purchasing.

sections.title: 14-day right of withdrawal
sections.body: If you are a consumer in the EU, EEA, or UK, you may withdraw from your purchase within 14 days of the transaction without giving a reason, in line with applicable consumer law. Consumers elsewhere may also request a refund within 14 days of purchase.

sections.title: How to request a refund
sections.body: Purchases are processed by Paddle as Merchant of Record, so refunds are issued by Paddle. Reply to your Paddle receipt email, or contact our support email with your order number, and we will process the request. Refunds are returned to the original payment method, typically within 5–10 business days.

sections.title: Subscription renewals
sections.body: Cancelling a Full subscription stops future renewals at any time. If a renewal charge was made within the last 14 days, you may request a refund of that charge.

support_page.title: Support — Meridian
support_page.meta_desc: Get help with Meridian — FAQs, contact form, and direct email support.
support_page.sub: Most questions are answered below. If not, use the contact form or email us directly.
support_page.email_note: We aim to reply within 1 business day.

faq_items.q: Where does Meridian store my data?
faq_items.a: On your machine, in a SQLite file at %APPDATA%\Meridian\meridian.db on Windows, or in a Docker volume you control. Nothing is sent to any Meridian server — there isn't one.

faq_items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
faq_items.a: The app switches to read-only mode — you can still view everything, but adding transactions, editing categories, and making changes requires a Base or Full license. Nothing is deleted.

faq_items.q: How do I activate my license?
faq_items.a: After purchasing, you'll receive a license key by email. Open Meridian, go to Settings → License, paste the key, and click Activate. The app connects to our activation server once to bind the key to your machine, then works offline after that.

faq_items.q: Can I access Meridian on my phone?
faq_items.a: Yes, on Base and Full. Go to Settings → Phone Access, generate a local HTTPS certificate, and you can reach the app from any browser on your home network — or anywhere via Tailscale.

faq_items.q: I lost my license key. Can I get it back?
faq_items.a: Your key was sent to the email you gave Paddle at checkout. Search for an email from Meridian or Paddle with the subject 'Your Meridian license'. If you can't find it, contact us with your order number.

faq_items.q: How do I import my bank statement?
faq_items.a: Go to the Upload tab, drag your CSV or XLS file, map the columns once, and Meridian handles the rest — categories, deduplication, balance tracking. CGD, Millennium, Santander, Montepio, and Activo Bank formats work without any extra configuration.

faq_items.q: Does Meridian work on Mac or Linux?
faq_items.a: The Electron desktop app is Windows-only for now. If you're on Linux, the Docker image works on any machine with Docker installed — same app, same features, accessed from your browser.

faq_items.q: What's the difference between Base and Full?
faq_items.a: Base is €39 once — no subscription, yours forever. Full is €59/year and adds net worth projections, savings rate tracking, milestone alerts, encrypted backups, and bank sync integrations. If you're unsure, Base covers the vast majority of everyday use.

faq_items.q: How do I cancel my Full subscription?
faq_items.a: Use the cancellation link in your Paddle receipt email, or contact us with your order number and we'll handle it. After cancellation, your subscription continues until the current period ends, then the app runs with Base features.

faq_items.q: My transactions aren't being categorised automatically.
faq_items.a: Auto-categorisation works from rules you create — Meridian doesn't ship with built-in rules because bank descriptions vary too much between banks and accounts. Go to Upload → Rules, add a few keyword rules for your regular merchants, and they'll apply to all matching transactions straight away.
